title: Cluster work by contribution and risk

C1.rule: Mechanical, one owned file, fully specified, no design choice

C2.rule: Bounded implementation or tests, clear spec, one or two owned files and their tests

C3.rule: Cross-module design; changes a gate or the ledger contract; wrong means every project inherits it

C4.rule: Planning, merging, reconciling, anything in a project's real data, a sponsor decision

phases.name: Research
phases.goal: Questions that need reading, not writing, before they become items, a proposal, or a decline.
phases.exit: Every X row is done only when it becomes items, a numbered proposal, or a recorded decline with the reason -- never a report nobody acted on.

asks.quote: So if the reviews and all that can be also done in clusters so reviews and main testing, so can you think of some kind of a formula where we can analyse and see what is the percentage of contribution by these changes in the overall changes, what might be the impact what might be the risk? Is it a user visible risk, or is it a pack and risk? Does it completely stop working? Everything? Does it improve something and based on the different priorities and different percentage of contribution and percentage of risk it prioritise how to cluster these tasks. So lower ones can be done like once in a day or once in a week or when something else is done, can be deferred for later. At least I want to get the 90% of the work done rather than focusing on the last 10% and the majority is completed, but things are tracked.
